name: page-feature-groups
goal: Group related list, detail and history pages by feature and teach that structure in generated agent guidance while preserving routes and unit identities

evidence: Planned feature specification defines nine route-feature groups, stable URLs/IDs, emitted agent guidance and desktop/tablet/mobile acceptance.

Existing module-groups and category browser scenarios used only synthetic Orders categories. Extended the shared fixture with actual registered page manifests and committed project taxonomy; generated-project and guide tests now require feature-folder guidance.
